create_ancestral_sampling: create an ancestral sampling function that generates k samples of autoregressive sequences using a State object
run_beam_search: run beam search decoding on an autoregressive model state with fixed beam width and max length
run_stochastic_beam_search: run stochastic beam search decoding with gumbel perturbation on a State object for autoregressive generation
build_gumbel_sampling: build numerically stable gumbel samples conditioned on a target maximum for stochastic beam search
test_state_class: test the State base class that defines logprobs, apply_transition, and is_finished interfaces for ancestral samplers
